states.label: Round open; some required seats have no verdict
Round settled with changes requested; one bounce counted
Round settled with every required seat approved

transitions.label: A seat approves while other required seats are still pending
A seat requests changes with fail_fast=false and other seats still pending
Every seat has a verdict and at least one requests changes
With fail_fast=true, the first accepted changes-requested verdict settles the round in one atomic step
A late, duplicate, recovered, or stale-head verdict is rejected and changes nothing
A verdict that cites a stale head is rejected
An operator adds seats to an open round
Adding seats to a settled round is refused

states.label: Seat claimed or queued with no verdict
Seat canceled or superseded by fail-fast settlement; never approved

transitions.label: The seat submits a verdict before settlement
A sibling seat's changes-requested verdict settled the round
A late claim, renewal, or verdict is refused
A sibling's changes-requested verdict settled the round; this accepted verdict is kept
